text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, I'm afraid that's all I have time
for! I
have things to attend to, so...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Just a little longer, pleeease! We have
so many
readers who are eager for a
Scarlet scoop! You're
fast becoming the
center of attention!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One morning, I notice a reporter
attempting to
land interviews at the
academy gates. Unable to
overlook his
unrelenting behavior, I move to

intervene, but just then...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: HEY!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You, there! Quit pestering students!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Y-you've got it all wrong! I just have a
job to do,
so—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah, so you need help? Ta-da!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm Aston Machan. You can call me
Machan. I'm
good friends with Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Your reputation precedes you! If
you don't
mind, Machan, I'd like to—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Right, let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't fret. Hishiama and I will offer
plenty of
exclusive scoops. I'd be
delighted if all the photos
made it to
print.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a moment, Machan! You don't
have to go
out of your way for me! And I
assume you're really
busy too, Hishi!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Don't worry, Scarlet—we've got
this! You
just get outta here!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And as for you, Mr. Reporter... you're okay with this too, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Oh, um... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Concerned about both the reporter and
Aston
Machan, I decide to stick around
and see how
things play out.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So! First, we have the cafeteria. I assume
you're
curious about what the students
eat.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This cafeteria is a cool spot that offers a
buffet at
lunchtime, then becomes a
cafe from three
o'clock. It even offers
seasonal dishes.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Oh, um... Wow.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you ever have any plans for a pop-up
cafe
event, be sure to involve me. I'd be
delighted to
participate. As a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ooh, you're cunning. But this guy was getting real pushy earlier—I guess you're just giving him a taste of his own medicine!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that girl over there—she's rumored
to be
Triple Crown material!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Enough with the ambush interviews!
Don't
forget you're on academy
grounds—students
come first here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Eep! I'm terribly sorry!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You're not permitted to look away. Your

correspondent for today is right here,
remember?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now that I have your undivided
attention, the
time has come for me to
show you my dancing.
Please take plenty
of pictures.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon admonishes the reporter
while
Aston Machan pulls him deeper
into her
marketing ploy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the reporter thoroughly trapped
between
two different kinds of intense
pressure, the
interview continues, until...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Well, that takes care of that!
And I think
the tour went pretty well
overall!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hishi! Machan! Um, I'm sorry for foisting
that
reporter on you both! You two
really saved me
back there...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it! When it comes
down to it,
we've all got each other's
backs!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes. And that reporter took plenty
of photos
of me as well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you ever need any help again, let me
know. It
might just be an opportunity for
a Machan
moment.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just remember that your friend Machan
is always
ready to swoop in and save
you. For future
requests, contact me via
LANE or my official
account.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her soft and gentle aura, Aston
Machan
really can be quite assertive.
Seeing that side of
her makes me
realize...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her soft and gentle aura, Aston
Machan
really can be quite assertive.
Seeing that side of
her makes me
realize...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oho, we could use that as our slogan.
"Together,
we're unstoppable."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Hishiama? From now
on, let's
make that declaration anytime
we team up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that be kinda extremely
embarrassing?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the duo that stepped in to help
out are
decidedly different in nature, I
realize that they
have in common a
strong sense of will.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm? I wonder what makes you say that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We have to make the most of every
moment,
Trainer. Whenever there's an
opportunity, let's
take it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's gentle but assertive... I come away
with a
renewed understanding of what
makes Aston
Machan who she is.
